text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock C after they rose locked in gains, but those gains don’t tell me whether selling was wise; past price movements don’t predict future returns.","I can become attached to a stock’s gain or loss relative to my average cost. I should assess each holding by its future prospects and its role in my overall portfolio, not by whether I’d have to admit a mistake.","Frequent account checks can invite unnecessary trades. I’ll follow a deliberate portfolio plan and trade only when the expected benefits justify changing my holdings."]}
